preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= n <= 500 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 5 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each of the 2n arrays has exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each element in the arrays is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(map(int, line.split()))) == n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each array is a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 * n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: There are exactly 2n arrays per test case.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly two lines per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() and line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout.splitlines().index(line) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case's output is a non-negative integer (the count of good subsets modulo 998244353).

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(idx) <= 2 * n for idx in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout.splitlines().index(line) % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case's output contains n indices between 1 and 2n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout.splitlines().index(line) % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case's output contains exactly n indices.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == n for line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout.splitlines().index(line) % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: The indices in the second line of each test case's output are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(arrays[i][j] == arrays[k][j] for j in range(n)) for i in range(n) for k in range(n) if i != k) for arrays in [get_arrays_for_test_case(stdin)])
postconditions.description: The selected subset of n arrays forms a Latin square, meaning for each column index j, the elements in that column across the n arrays are all distinct and cover 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(count_line) < 998244353 for count_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout.splitlines().index(count_line) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The count of good subsets is a non-negative integer less than 998244353.
